fields.value: Avoid reloading an oversized eval checkpoint on every forward

When a loaded checkpoint is larger than the per-owner allowance, Forwards.answer loads it to make progress and immediately evicts it on return, even if it is the only checkpoint. The next call to that same checkpoint reloads it. Direct play divides memory_gb across game processes, so this can happen when the model fits host memory but is larger than its share.

Define and document the cache allowance when the minimum working set is one checkpoint. Avoid reloads on repeated requests to one oversized checkpoint without accumulating multiple oversized entries. Verify load counts with synthetic checkpoint lengths, including switching checkpoints. This crosses the checkpoint cache residency and memory contract, independent of Apple Silicon topology. No production slowdown was reproduced in the M4 Max measurement.

Evidence: Etude PR #152, Task 310ac1 scratch/concept-review.html (F3), src/etude/eval/forwards.py (Forwards.answer and _evict).
